Our analysis

Of the 14 MPVs in our comparison, the Dacia Jogger TCe 110 is the 3rd cheapest to own.

How much does a Dacia Jogger TCe 110 cost per month?

About €390 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.312 per km.
